description: Component for ingesting documents for RAG/Q&A systems.

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Name of the asset to create

source_path.label: Source Path
source_path.description: Path to documents directory or file

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Upstream asset keys this asset depends on (e.g. ['raw_orders', 'schema/asset'])

include_preview_metadata.description: Include a preview of the output data in metadata (first 5 rows as a markdown table). Used by builder UIs to render asset shape without warehouse access.
include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata

preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata when `include_preview_metadata` is True. For long DataFrames (>10x preview_rows), a random sample is used so the preview reflects the data distribution; otherwise head() is used.
preview_rows.label: Preview Rows

partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', or None for unpartitioned. With a partition type set, the partition key is exposed via context.partition_key for use in filtering / templating.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required when partition_type is set.
partition_start.label: Partition Start

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

owners.description: Asset owners — team names ('team:analytics') or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds for the catalog (e.g. ['snowflake', 'python']). Auto-inferred from component name when unset.
kinds.label: Kinds

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before the asset is considered stale. Builds a FreshnessPolicy when set.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag Minutes

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule string for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron

column_lineage.label: Column Lineage
column_lineage.description: Column-level lineage, emitted as `dagster/column_lineage` metadata on every materialization: {output column: [upstream columns]}, e.g. {'revenue': ['price', 'quantity']}. The upstream asset is `upstream_asset_key`, or the only entry of `deps`; with several upstream assets, name each column '<asset_key>:<column>'. Ignored with a warning when no upstream asset can be resolved.

partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter the upstream DataFrame to the current date partition key.
partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme,globex,initech'.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_static_dim.description: Dimension name for the static axis in multi-partitioning, e.g. 'customer'.
partition_static_dim.label: Partition Static Dim

partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter the upstream DataFrame to the current static partition value.
partition_static_column.label: Partition Static Column

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset. 'single_run' materializes an entire backfill range in one run: the full dataset is fetched once (as always) and then filtered down to the whole range via Partition Date Column/Partition Static Column (same mechanism as a normal tick, just spanning more rows). 'multi_run' launches one run per partition (optionally capped via Backfill Max Partitions Per Run). Leave empty for Dagster's default (one run per partition, uncapped). Ignored when Partition Type is not set. Requires a partition-range-aware IO manager (e.g. a DB-table IO manager with partition_expr set) -- a generic filesystem/default IO manager cannot persist a single_run output spanning multiple partitions and will raise a clear error at materialization time.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For Backfill Policy = 'multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run. Leave empty for Dagster's default (1).

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition. 0 (the Dagster default) means a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows -- e.g. a daily set never includes today until tomorrow. Set to 1 to include the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition (defaults to UTC when unset, matching Dagster's own default).

name: Document Ingestion
